svg.text: Figure 9.2. The Tracer's output path: the FIFOs, the two compressor sets, the packers and the output queues
v1.3 (spec §4.21.6, §4.21.3) — block level; the stream's data in blue, the state record in purple, control in orange
one code value per instruction or padding row; at most one log word per row
the state record, read in place as output queue 0 (4.21.6)
set 1: sizing as the rows run (4.21.6)
the coded bits are counted, then discarded;
the tag picks the encoder; loads (tag 0) update E[15]
reset to all zeros by PULSE_RUN
the choice, when the rows end
per stream: LRU-coded if fewer 128-bit words than raw, raw on a tie;
68 words, in place, by a read pointer
one transfer at a time (PULSE_DMA), sized
by C&C 3 to the credits and words 37–39
out through its down port to tile 2 (item 118)
packets into the compute tiles' memory (first implementation, 4.21.6)
the service flags reach C&C 3 as its EVENTS [13] (4.21.3)
the state record and its totals
Each word the core logs goes into its FIFO and through set 1, which sizes its stream as the rows run. When the rows end, set 1's sizes choose raw or coded per stream and
give the state record its totals; then one scan of each FIFO drives set 2 and the packers into output queues 1–3, each with its credits and service flag, and the DMA sends them,
with output queue 0, the state record read in place. The drain's order (the state queue's service, the streams, done last) is in spec 4.21.6.
